about: Chapter 83 lists the kings descended from Ishmael and from Isaac, all of Shem’s line, and ends on Christ as king of kings. In chapter 84 the king of Ethiopia returns home in joy; Makeda is told by messengers, summons her people, and the Ark is brought to her city. In 85 she sees Zion and worships, tents are pitched at Däbrä Makeda, guards are set over the Ark, and the realms of Solomon and Makeda are praised. In 86 she crowns her son and gives him horses, mules, gold and the regalia.

sentences.n: ወበእንተዝ ‘and on account of this’ (በእንተ + ዝ). ኮኑ ‘they became’ (perfect 3mp of ኮነ); ነገሥተ ደቂቀ ይስማዔል is literally ‘kings-of sons-of Ishmael’; I read it as a predicate with the sons of Ishmael as subject, ‘the sons of Ishmael became kings’ (the -ä endings can be accusative or construct, so the chain is uncertain, ?). ላዕለ ‘over’ is repeated with ወ- for the first three names (ትርብ, ቅብጥ, ኖባ); the later names ride on it. The list is a catalogue of peoples and lands, mostly of Africa (Arabia too, ?): ቅብጥ is the Copts (Egypt), ኖባ Nubia, ሊባ perhaps Libya; ትርብ, ሶበ, ኵርጒ, ሪፊ, ማካ, ሞርና, ፊንቃና, ኣርሲባና and መስዕ I cannot identify with confidence, and I give them in transliteration (?). The Ishmaelites hold power because Ishmael, too, is of the line of Shem (next unit).

sentences.i: And the seed of Isaac also reigned over Judah, over the Amorites, the Hittites, the Jebusites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, the Kelkedeans (?), Rome, Antioch, Syria, Armenia, Philistia, Ethiopia, Edom, the Ilofli (the “Foreigners”, i.e. Philistines, as elsewhere in this book), Ioab (?), Amalek, Afragya (?), Babylon, Yonanst (?), and the Hebrews (?).
sentences.n: ወዘርአ ይስሓቅኒ: the enclitic -ኒ adds ‘also, indeed’ and sets Isaac’s seed beside Ishmael’s. ነግሠ ‘he reigned’ is singular, agreeing with the collective ዘርአ. The first names are the Canaanite peoples of Exodus 3:8, compare Genesis 15:19–21 (አሞሬዎን Amorites, ኬጤዎን Hittites, ኢያቡሴዎን Jebusites, ፌርዜዎን Perizzites, ኤዌዎን Hivites). Then come Rome and Antioch, Syria and Armenia, Philistia, Ethiopia, Edom, Amalek and Babylon. ኬልቄዴዎን may be Chaldeans or Chalcedon; ኢሎፍሊ is, as in chs. 49–81, ‘foreigners, Philistines’ (Greek allophyloi, Psalm 87:4); of the rest, ኢዮኣብ (Moab?), አፍራግያ (Africa or Phrygia?), ዮናንስጥ (Greece or the Greeks?) and ዕብራይስጥ (the Hebrews or their language?) are uncertain (?). The book wants the line of Isaac to hold the Christian world, the Ethiopian kingdom included.

sentences.i: The seed of Shem has the high throne and authority, as his father Noah blessed Shem, his son, by the word of God, saying: “Be lord over your brothers, and reign over them”;
sentences.n: ልዑል መንበር ‘high throne’ and ምኵናን ‘authority, rule’ carry no verb: ‘(there is) high throne … to the seed of Shem’, a nominal sentence with ለ- of possession. ባረኮ ‘he blessed him’; በቃለ ‘by the word of’ (construct). ለሤም ወልዲ ‘to Shem, his son’: ወልዲ is ወልድ with -ዲ written for the 3ms suffix -ሁ, as elsewhere in this book (‘my son’ is the other possible reading, ?). እንዘ ይብል ‘saying’ is the standard quotation frame. The imperatives ኵን ‘be!’ and ንግሥ ‘reign!’ echo Isaac’s blessing of Jacob, Genesis 27:29 (‘be lord over your brothers’); the book puts it in Noah’s mouth for Shem, whom Genesis 9:26 also blesses.

sentences.i: And this that he said was about the Saviour, who is king for all of us, Jesus Christ, king of heaven and earth, who it is that makes kings great, and who again abolishes the authority of those he wishes to (?);
sentences.n: ዘንተ ‘this’ (accusative of the demonstrative) ዘይቤ ‘which he said’ (ዘ- + perfect). መድኅን ‘saviour’; ዘለኵልነ ‘who is for all of us’ (ዘ- + ለ- + ኵሉ + -ነ ‘us’). ንጉሠ ሰማያት ወምድር ‘king of heaven and earth’, constructs. ዘውእቱ ‘who (it is)’ + ያዐቢ ‘he makes great’, imperfect of the causative አዐበየ. The close reads ‘for those whom he wished again to abolish their authority’: ፈቀደ ‘he wished’ + ይስዕር ‘he abolishes’ (ሰዐረ ‘destroy, abolish’); the exact grammar is hard (?). The pious turn: the earthly kings listed above hold power only from Christ, the true king (compare Daniel 2:21).

sentences.i: As for the king of Ethiopia, he entered his city in great joy and delight, with all the sound of their songs, their harps and their chariots, like a host of heavenly beings; as they ran, they arrived, their bells (?) coming from Jerusalem, on the day of the city and Qerom (?).
sentences.n: ንጉሠ ኢትዮጵያሰ: the enclitic -ሰ is contrastive, ‘as for’, turning from the Ishmaelites to Ethiopia. ቦአ ‘he entered’. በዐቢይ ፍሥሓ ‘in great joy’ (በ- ‘in, with’). ቃለ ‘voice of’ (construct). The nouns ማሕሌቶሙ ‘their songs’, ዕንዚራቲሆሙ ‘their harps’, ሰረገላቲሆሙ ‘their chariots’ carry -ሙ / -ሆሙ ‘their’. ከመ ኀይለ ሰማያዊያን ‘like the host of the heavenly ones’ (ሰማያዊ ‘heavenly’). እንዘ ይረውጹ ‘while they run’ (እንዘ + imperfect). ደወሎሙ I take as ‘their bells’ (?); in በዕለት ሀገረ ወቄሮም the sense ‘on the day of the city and Qerom’ is uncertain, and ቄሮም is probably a place name (?).

sentences.i: And they sent to her by ships to tell Makeda, queen of Ethiopia, and her followers (?) how they had found all good things, how her son had become king, and how they had brought heavenly Zion; she was informed of all this glory, and she sent a herald (?) round through the whole kingdom beneath her, that they receive her son, and above all that which concerned heavenly Zion, the ark of the God of Israel;
sentences.n: ወለአኩ ‘and they sent’ (perfect 3mp); ላቲ ‘to her’; በአሕማር ‘by ships’ (አሕማር plural of ሐመር). ከመ ይንግርዋ ‘that they tell her’ (ከመ + subjunctive + -ዋ ‘her’). ለማክዳ ንግሥተ ኢትዮጵያ ‘Makeda, queen of Ethiopia’, queen in construct. አርድእዋ ‘her disciples’; here likely her followers or officials (?). ዘከመ ‘how’ is repeated three times, each with a perfect verb. አምጽእዋ ለጽዮን ‘they brought her, Zion’: Zion, the Ark, is grammatically feminine (cf. ‘the heavenly Zion’ ሰማያዊት). ተዜነወት ‘she was informed’ (tä-stem, 3fs). አዖደት ‘she sent round’ (causative of ዐወደ, ‘go round’) with ዐዋዴ ‘a herald or proclamation’ (?). ዘእምታሕቴሃ ‘which (is) from beneath her’, i.e. under her rule (ዘ- + እም- + ታሕት + -ሃ). ከመ ትትቀበሎ ‘that they receive him’ (ተቀበለ, 3fs for the kingdom). ወፈድፋደሰ ‘and above all’. ታቦተ ‘ark of’: Zion is the Ark of the Covenant (ታቦት), which Menelik brought from Jerusalem; this is the book’s central theology.

sentences.i: Her son came by the road of Azyaba and Qiro (?), went out by Mäsäs (?), went up to Bur (?), and came to the city of Məsfəna, the head of Ethiopia, which she herself had built and named after herself, and it was called Däbrä Makeda, the Mount of Makeda.
sentences.n: ወመጽአ ‘and he came’; ወልዳ ‘her son’ (ወልድ + -ሃ) is Menelik, now David. እንተ ፍኖተ I read as ‘by the road of’ (?); the feminine relative እንተ is used as a preposition. ወወፅአ ‘went out’, ወዐርገ ‘went up’ (ዐርገ ‘ascend’), with the places መሰስ and ቡር (?). ዘለሊሃ አሕነጸታ ‘which she herself built it’ (አሕነጸት, 3fs perfect of the causative አሕነጸ of ሐነጸ ‘build’, + -ኣ ‘it’, giving -ታ; ለሊሃ ‘herself’). በስማ ‘in her name’. ተብህለት ‘it was called’ (tä-stem of ብህለ, 3fs). ደብረ ‘mount of’ construct. The series of ፨ marks the chapter’s end.

sentences.i: Then she saw holy Zion high up (?), shining like the sun; and when she saw her she gave thanks and praised the God of Israel, and bowed down, bent her neck, lifted her head, gazed into heaven, and thanked her Creator; she spread out her hands (?), cried out with her mouth (?), trod with her feet (?), and adorned all her body with joy, and she rejoiced in spirit with all her inward being (?).
sentences.n: A long chain of 3fs perfects, each joined by ወ-, as the Queen’s body takes part in worship. ርእየታ ‘she saw her’ (3fs perfect ርእየት + -ኣ ‘her’, giving -ታ); the object is restated as ለጽዮን ቅድስት ‘Zion the holy’, the Ark. በመልዕልት ‘on high, above’ (መልዕልት ‘height’; the exact sense is uncertain, ?). እንዘ ታበርህ ‘while she shines’ (causative of በርሀ, ‘be bright’); ከመ እንተ ፀሐይ ‘like that (f.) of the sun’. አእኰተቶ ‘she gave thanks to him’ and ሰብሐቶ ‘she praised him’ (3fs perfect + -ኦ ‘him’, giving -ቶ); ለአምላከ እስራኤል repeats the object, ‘God of Israel’. ሰገደት ‘bowed’, ጐድአት ‘she bent’, አልዐለት ‘she raised’ (causative of ዐለወ), ነጸረት ‘she looked’. The actions of the hands, mouth and feet (ጠፍሐት, የበበት, አጽሐሰት) are uncertain verbs, and I give the likeliest sense from context: clapping or spreading hands, ululation, stamping or dancing (?). አሰርገወት ‘she adorned’; ተሐሥየት ‘she was glad’ (tä-stem); ኵሉ ውሳጥያቲሃ ‘all her inward parts’ I take as the seat of her gladness, ‘in spirit, with all her inward parts’ (?). The scene recalls David dancing before the Ark (2 Samuel 6:14).

sentences.i: For in those days Solomon was king in Jerusalem and Makeda was queen in Ethiopia, and to both of them were given wisdom, glory, wealth, favour, knowledge, eloquence, and understanding;
sentences.n: The nominal clauses በኢየሩሳሌም ሰሎሞን ንጉሥ ‘in Jerusalem, Solomon king’ and በኢትዮጵያ መክዳ ንግሥት need no verb. ለክልኤሆሙ ‘to the two of them’ (ክልኤቱ ‘two’ + -ሆሙ). ተውህበ ‘it was given’ (tä-stem of ወሀበ, singular, agreeing with the first noun). ሞገስ ‘favour, grace’; ሥነ ቃል ‘beauty of speech’ (ሥነ construct); ልቡና ‘understanding’. The author sets Solomon and Makeda side by side as equals, each with a kingdom, recalling the book’s theme of the two kingdoms, Jerusalem and Ethiopia.

The ፨ series ends the chapter.

sentences.l: And-on third day she-presented-him to-her-son horses chosen who they-guard watchers-of enemy and-they-ravage again cities-of enemy 700 and-10,000 and-7,000 and-mares-of horses who they-give-birth 70-and-700 and-mules-of females 1,000 and-mules-of males chosen 700 and-garments-of glory gold and-silver counted by-gomor and-as-much measure-of kor each sixth and-seventh and-she-presented-him all that-by-his-law and-throne-of kingdom-also;
sentences.i: On the third day she presented to her son chosen horses, such as watch out for enemy scouts (?) and moreover ravage the cities of the enemy, 17,700 of them; mares (?) that bear foals, 770; female mules, 1,000; chosen male mules, 700; garments of honour; gold and silver, counted out by the gomor, and by the measure of the kor, by sixths and sevenths (?); and she presented him with all that is by his law (?) and the throne of the kingdom as well;
sentences.n: A long list of gifts, in the accusative (አፍራሰ ‘horses’, ጋኝተ ‘mares’ (a guess from እለ ይወልዳ ‘which bear’, ?), በቅለ ‘mules’, ወርቀ ‘gold’, ብሩረ ‘silver’), all objects of አወፈየቶ ‘she presented him’ (causative of ወፈየ, ‘give gifts’). አመ ሣልስት ዕለት ‘on the third day’. እለ የዐቅቡ ተዓይነ ፀር ‘which keep (watch for) the ተዓይን of the enemy’, where ተዓይን may be ‘lookouts, scouts’ (?); ወያመዘብሩ ‘and which ravage’ (መዘበረ, causative, ‘plunder’). The numbers: ፯፻ ወ፼ ወ፸፻ is 700 + 10,000 + 7,000, i.e. 17,700; ፸ወ፯፻ is 770; ፲፻ is 1,000; ፯፻ is 700. ጎሞር is the omer or gomor (Exodus 16:36) and ቆሮስ the kor (a dry measure); በበ ሳድስ ወሳብዕ ‘by sixths and sevenths’ I cannot fit to a clear sense (?). ዘበሕጉ ‘what is by his law’ and ወመንበረ መንግሥታኒ ‘and the throne of the kingdom too’ (-ኒ ‘also’) are uncertain: perhaps the royal customs and regalia of the Queen’s realm (?).

glossary.ምስፍና: ምስፍና — Məsfəna (place name), the same word as the common noun ምስፍና 'rule, lordship', from which the city's name is taken (?)
glossary.ሠናይ: ሠናይ — good, beautiful (adj.) · 'good' as a substantive (ዘይረክበከ ሠናይ 'what good will find you')
glossary.ሣልስት: ሣልስ — third (ordinal, fem. ሣልስት; ሣልስት ዕለት 'third day')
glossary.ርእየታ: ርእየ — she saw her (3fs perfect, G, r-ʾ-y, + -ኣ '3fs her', written -ታ)
glossary.ሰማያዊያን: ሰማያዊ — heavenly ones (adjective, plural -ያን, used as noun)
glossary.ሰብአ: ሰብእ — man (accusative) · construct 'men of' (ሰብአ ቤቱ 'men of his house')
glossary.ስልጣኖሙ: ስልጣን — their authority, power (noun + -ሙ '3mp their', accusative)
glossary.ስፉረ: ስፉር — counted, measured out (passive participle of ሰፈረ 'measure, count', accusative) (?)
glossary.ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?)
glossary.ቅብጥ: ቅብጥ — the Copts, Egypt (proper name, collective)
glossary.ቆሮስ: ቆሮስ — kor (a large dry measure; Hebrew kor) (noun)
glossary.በመልዕልት: መልዕልት — on high, in the height, above (በ- + noun 'height'; exact sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.በመንፈስ: መንፈስ — by the spirit (በ- 'by, in' + noun; በመንፈስ ቅዱስ 'by the Holy Spirit')
glossary.በስማ: ስም — in her name (በ- + noun + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.በቃለ: ቃል — by the word of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በቃላ: ቃል — by her voice (በ- + noun + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.በቅድሜሃ: ቅድሜ — before her (በ- + noun ቅድሜ- 'front' + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.በበ: በበ — each, every, by (distributive, doubled preposition በ-)
glossary.በብዙኅ: ብዙኅ — with much (በ- + adjective, masc. sg.)
glossary.በአፉሃ: አፍ — with her mouth (በ- + noun አፍ, አፉ- + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
glossary.በእደዊሃ: እድ — with her hands (በ- + plural እደው, oblique እደዊ- + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.በእገሪሃ: እግር — with her feet (በ- + plural እገር + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
glossary.በውእቱ: ውእቱ — in that (በ- + demonstrative, before መዋዕል 'days')
glossary.በዕለት: ዕለት — on the day of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በጎሞር: ጎሞር — by the gomor (በ- + noun; the omer, Exodus 16:36)
glossary.ባሕረ: ባሕር — sea (noun, accusative of place 'by sea') · accusative object or goal: 'reached the sea' (ወበጽሑ ባሕረ), 'crossed the sea' (ዐደዉ ባሕረ), 'came out of the sea' (ወወፅኡ ባሕረ), ch. 55 · construct 'sea of' (ባሕረ ኢርትራ 'the Sea of Erythra, the Red Sea')
glossary.ባረኮ: ባረከ — he blessed him (3ms perfect, b-r-k + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ብርት: ብርት — (?) a metal or common material; word unconfirmed (compare Amharic ብረት 'iron')
glossary.ቦአ: ቦአ — he entered (3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
glossary.ተውህበ: ወሀበ — it was given (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive)
glossary.ተዓይነ: ተዓይን — scouts, lookouts (?) (noun, construct 'scouts of'; sense from context) (?)
glossary.ተዜነወት: ዜነወ — she was informed (3fs perfect, tä-stem passive of the quadriliteral ዜነወ 'tell, announce', z-n-w)
glossary.ተፈሥሐት: ተፈሥሐ — rejoice, be glad (3fs perfect, T stem; subject ሀገር)
glossary.ታበርህ: አብርሀ — she shines (3fs imperfect, causative of በርሀ 'be bright'; subject Zion)
glossary.ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
glossary.ትርብ: ትርብ — Tarb (a people or land in the list of Ishmaelite realms; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ትትቀበሎ: ተቀበለ — that she receive him (3fs subjunctive, tä-stem, q-b-l + -ኦ '3ms him', written -ሎ; or 2ms 'you receive him') (?)
glossary.ኀስረ: ኀሰረ — it lacked, was lessened (3ms perfect, G, ḫ-s-r; before ከመ, 'was made worth little') (?)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
glossary.ኀያላነ: ኀያል — mighty ones (noun, plural ኀያላን, construct 'mighty ones of')
glossary.ኀይለ: ኀይል — strength (noun, accusative ኀይለ) · construct 'host of' (ኀይለ ሰማይ 'host of heaven') · 'power' (ትገብሩ ኀይለ ከማየ 'you do power like me') · construct 'power of' (ኀይለ ጸላኢ 'the power of the enemy')
glossary.ኅሩያነ: ኅሩይ — chosen (adjective/noun, plural ኅሩያን, accusative ኅሩያነ)
glossary.ኆልቈ: ኆልቍ — number, count (noun, accusative ኆልቈ; ዘአልቦ ኆልቈ 'without number')
glossary.ነገሥተ: ንጉሥ — kings (noun, plural ነገሥት, construct 'kings of') · accusative 'kings' as object (ያዐቢ ነገሥተ 'he makes kings great') · predicate 'as kings' (ኮኑ ነገሥተ 'they became kings', ?)
glossary.ነግሠ: ነግሠ — he reigned (3m sg perfect, n-g-š)
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
glossary.ንግሥተ: ንግሥት — queen (noun, fem.; construct 'queen of' before the following noun)
glossary.አህጉረ: ሀገር — cities (noun; plural አህጉር, accusative form)
glossary.አሌባ: አሌባ — Aleba (a sea or place name; unidentified) (?)
glossary.አሕነጸታ: ሐነጸ — she built it (3fs perfect, causative አሕነጸ of ሐነጸ 'build', ḥ-n-ṣ, + -ኣ '3fs it', written -ታ)
glossary.አምጽእዋ: አምጽአ — they brought her (3mp perfect, causative of መጽአ, + -ሃ '3fs her', written -ዋ)
glossary.አርትዐት: ርትዐ — she set right, ruled justly (3fs perfect, causative አርትዐ of ርትዐ 'be upright', r-t-ʿ) (?)
glossary.አስተዳለወት: ደለወ — she prepared (3fs perfect, ʾastä-stem of ደለወ 'be ready', d-l-w)
glossary.አንገሠቶ: ነግሠ — she made him king (3fs perfect, causative አንገሠ of ነግሠ 'reign', + -ኦ '3ms him', written -ቶ)
glossary.አእኰተቶ: አእኰተ — she gave thanks to him (3fs perfect, causative, ʾ-k-w-t, + -ኦ '3ms him', written -ቶ)
glossary.አወፈየቶ: ወፈየ — she presented him (3fs perfect, causative አወፈየ of ወፈየ 'give gifts', + -ኦ '3ms him', written -ቶ)
glossary.አዝያባ: አዝያባ — Azyaba (place name on the road; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ኢትዮጵያሰ: ኢትዮጵያ — Ethiopia, as for Ethiopia (proper name + enclitic -ሰ 'as for', contrastive)
glossary.ኣሴካ: ኣሴካ — Aseka (a sea or place name; unidentified; spelled with ኣ) (?)
glossary.እሊአሃ: እሊአሃ — those of hers, her ones (?) (pronoun/demonstrative + -ሃ '3fs her'; ምስለ እሊአሃ 'with those of hers') (?)
glossary.እሙ: እም — his mother (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted እሙ) · 'its mother' of an animal (ጽጉበ ሐሊበ እሙ 'sated with its mother's milk'; ch. 53)
glossary.እምቅድሜሃ: ቅድሜ — before her, prior to her (እም- + noun ቅድሜ 'front' + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
glossary.እምንኡስ: ንኡስ — from small, from the small one (እም- + adjective, masc. sg.)
glossary.እስማኤላውያን: እስማኤላዊ — Ishmaelites, those of Ishmael (adjective/noun from the name እስማኤል with -ዊ, here plural -ውያን; the ending that marks peoples; dependent on the construct ንጉሠ)
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እብል: ብህለ — shall I say (1cs imperfect, b-h-l)
glossary.እኁ: እኁዝ — holders (first part of the wrongly divided እኁዛነ 'holders of'; read እኁ ዛነ as one word; see እኁዛነ: plural እኁዛን, participle of አኀዘ 'hold')
glossary.እኁዛነ: እኁዝ — holders, holding (passive-form participle of አኀዘ 'hold'; plural እኁዛን, construct 'holders of')
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እግዚአ: እግዚእ — lord (noun; accusative predicate in -a, after ኩን) · construct 'lord of' (እግዚአ ኵሉ 'Lord of all')
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ክርስትያነ: ክርስትያን — Christians (noun ክርስትያን 'Christian', here collective; construct 'Christians of'; the plural form is not certain, ?)
glossary.ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine') · 'it was' of time (ሶበ ኮነ ጊዜ ድራር 'when it was time for supper'); ወኮነ ፀዋገ 'he became (grim)'
glossary.ኮኑ: ኮነ — they became (3mp perfect, k-w-n) · 'so they were' in a simile (ከማሁ ኮኑ 'thus they were')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ኵላ: ኵሉ — all, the whole (variant form ኵላ, accusative)
glossary.ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55)
glossary.ወለአኩ: ለአከ — and I sent (ወ- + 1cs perfect, G, l-ʾ-k) · and they sent (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ለአኩ; ወለአኩ ላቲ በአሕማር 'and they sent to her by ships')
glossary.ወለእለ: እለ — and to those who (ወ- + ለ- + relative pronoun pl.)
glossary.ወለወልዳሂ: ወልድ — and for her son too (ወ- + ለ- + noun + -ኣ '3fs her' + enclitic -ሂ 'also, too')
glossary.ወሊባ: ሊባ — and Liba (ወ- + proper name; perhaps Libya) (?)
glossary.ወላዕለ: ላዕለ — and against (ወ- + preposition ላዕለ 'upon, over, against')
glossary.ወልዲ: ወልድ — my son (noun + 1cs suffix -ī, written -ዲ; variant of ወልድየ) (?) · his son (noun + -ዲ for 3ms -ሁ 'his', Bezold's spelling; ለሰሎሞን ወልዲ 'to Solomon, his son'; ለአድራሚ ወልዲ 'Adrami, his son')
glossary.ወመስዕ: መስዕ — and Mesʿ (ወ- + proper name, a people or land; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወመንበረ: መንበር — and the throne of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወመኳንንቲሃ: መኰንን — and her nobles, officials (ወ- + plural መኳንንት + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ወመጠነ: መጠን — and as much as, according to the measure of (ወ- + noun, accusative used as a conjunction)
glossary.ወመጽአ: መጽአ — and he came (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወማካ: ማካ — and Maka (ወ- + proper name, a people or land; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወምንተ: ምንት — and what? (ወ- 'and' + interrogative pronoun, accusative)
glossary.ወሞርና: ሞርና — and Morna (ወ- + proper name, a people or land; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወሥነ: ሥን — and the beauty of (ወ- + noun 'beauty', construct accusative)
glossary.ወሪፊ: ሪፊ — and Rifi (ወ- + proper name, a people or land; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወሮምያ: ሮምያ — and Rome (ወ- + proper name, variant of ሮም)
glossary.ወሰረገላቲሆሙ: ሰረገላ — and their chariots (ወ- + plural ሰረገላት + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ወሰብሐቶ: ሰብሐ — and she praised him (ወ- + 3fs perfect + -ኦ '3ms him', written -ቶ)
glossary.ወሰገደት: ሰገደ — and she bowed down (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G; subject ባሕር, fem.)
glossary.ወሶበ: ሶበ — and when (ወ- + conjunction) · and Sobo (ወ- + proper name ሶበ, in the list of lands ruled by the Ishmaelites, ወሶበ ወኵርጒ; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወቂሮ: ቂሮ — and Qiro (ወ- + place name; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወቄሮም: ቄሮም — and Qerom (ወ- + probably a place name; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወበቅለ: በቅል — and mules (ወ- + noun, accusative; collective, before አንስት 'female' / ተባዕት 'male')
glossary.ወበኢትዮጵያ: ኢትዮጵያ — and in Ethiopia (ወ- + በ- 'in' + proper name)
glossary.ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
glossary.ወበጽሐ: በጽሐ — and he reached (ወ- + 3ms perfect, b-ṣ-ḥ)
glossary.ወበጽሐት: በጽሐ — and she arrived (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ወባቲ: በ — and by it, with it (ወ- + preposition በ + -ቲ '3fs', ባቲ) · and she has, 'and in her is' (ወባቲ ክብረ ወብዕለ 'and she had glory and wealth'; on the pattern of ቦ 'there is to him')
glossary.ወብዕለ: ብዕል — and riches, wealth (ወ- + noun, accusative)
glossary.ወተሐሥየት: ተሐሥየ — and she rejoiced, was glad (ወ- + 3fs perfect, tä-stem, ḥ-ś-y)
glossary.ወተብህለት: ብህለ — and it was called (ወ- + 3fs perfect, tä-stem passive of ብህለ 'say')
glossary.ወተንሥኡ: ተንሥአ — and they arose (ወ- + 3mp perfect, Gt)
glossary.ወተከለት: ተከለ — and she pitched, planted (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G, t-k-l)
glossary.ወኀይመታተ: ኀይመት — and tents, shelters (ወ- + noun, plural ኀይመታት, accusative)
glossary.ወነጸረት: ነጸረ — and she looked (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ወነፍኁ: ነፍሐ — and they blew (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — and king of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወንግሥ: ነግሠ — and reign! (ወ- + 2ms imperative, G, n-g-š)
glossary.ወአልባሰ: ልብስ — and garments (ወ- + plural አልባስ, accusative)
glossary.ወአልዐለት: አልዐለ — and she raised, lifted (ወ- + 3fs perfect, causative of ዐለወ 'be high', ʿ-l-w)
glossary.ወአመ: አመ — and when, on the day that (ወ- + conjunction/preposition)
glossary.ወአርድእዋ: ረድእ — and her disciples, followers (?) (ወ- + plural አርድእ + -ሃ '3fs her', written -ዋ; the linking -ው- is unexplained) (?)
glossary.ወአሰርገወት: አሰርገወ — and she adorned (ወ- + 3fs perfect, causative of the quadriliteral ሰርገወ 'adorn')
glossary.ወአስተጋብአት: አስተጋብአ — and she gathered (ወ- + 3fs perfect, ʾastä-stem, causative of ተጋብአ, itself from ገብአ)
glossary.ወአስዋረ: አስዋር — and aswar (ወ- + an unidentified word, apparently a kind of animal; accusative) (?)
glossary.ወአንበርዋ: አነበረ — and they placed her (ወ- + causative 3mp perfect of ነበረ + -ዋ 'her')
glossary.ወአእምሮ: አእምሮ — and knowledge (ወ- + verbal noun of አእመረ)
glossary.ወአእኰተቶ: አእኰተ — and she gave thanks to him (ወ- + 3fs perfect, causative, ʾ-k-w-t, + -ኦ '3ms him', written -ቶ)
glossary.ወአወፈየቶ: ወፈየ — and she presented him (ወ- + 3fs perfect, causative አወፈየ of ወፈየ, + -ኦ '3ms him', written -ቶ)
glossary.ወአዖደት: አዖደ — and she sent round, made go round (ወ- + 3fs perfect, causative of ዐወደ 'go round') (?)
glossary.ወአግበረት: አግበረ — and she appointed, set (ወ- + 3fs perfect, causative of ገብረ 'do, make')
glossary.ወአጽሐሰት: አጽሐሰ — and she trod, stamped (?) (ወ- + 3fs perfect; the stem and root are uncertain, perhaps causative; sense from context) (?)
glossary.ወአፍራግያ: አፍራግያ — and Afragya (ወ- + proper name; perhaps Africa or Phrygia) (?)
glossary.ወኢሎፍሊ: ኢሎፍሊ — and the Foreigners, the Philistines (ወ- + collective noun; Greek allophyloi, Psalm 87:4)
glossary.ወኢያቡሴዎን: ኢያቡሴዎን — and the Jebusites (ወ- 'and' + ethnic name, plural)
glossary.ወኢይከውንሂ: ኮነ — and it will not be either (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, G, k-w-n, + enclitic -ሂ 'also, even')
glossary.ወኢዮኣብ: ኢዮኣብ — and Ioab (ወ- + proper name; perhaps Moab) (?)
glossary.ወኣርሲባና: ኣርሲባና — and Arsibana (ወ- + proper name, a people or land; unidentified; spelled with ኣ) (?)
glossary.ወኤዌዎን: ኤዌዎን — and the Hivites (ወ- 'and' + ethnic name, plural)
glossary.ወእሊአሃ: እሊአሃ — and those of hers, her peers (?) (ወ- + pronoun/demonstrative + -ሃ '3fs her'; see the plain form) (?)
glossary.ወእምተባዕት: ተባዕት — and from male, from males (ወ- + እም- + noun / adjective, masc.)
glossary.ወእምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወእምአንስት: ብእሲት — and from women (ወ- + እም- + broken plural አንስት)
glossary.ወእንስሳ: እንስሳ — and livestock, animals (ወ- + collective noun, accusative)
glossary.ወኬልቄዴዎን: ኬልቄዴዎን — and the Kelkedeans (ወ- + ethnic name, plural; perhaps Chaldeans, or Chalcedon) (?)
glossary.ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
glossary.ወኵርጒ: ኵርጒ — and Kurgu (ወ- + proper name, a people or land; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወወፅአ: ወፅአ — and he went out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወውስቴታ: ውስተ — and in it, in her (ወ- + preposition ውስተ, ውስቴ- + -ታ '3fs her/it', the form of the suffix on prepositions)
glossary.ወዐርገ: ዐርገ — and he ascended (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ʿ-r-g)
glossary.ወዕብራይስጥ: ዕብራይስጥ — and the Hebrews (ወ- + ethnic name; or the Hebrew language) (?)
glossary.ወዕንዚራቲሆሙ: ዕንዚራ — and their harps (ወ- + plural ዕንዚራት + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ወዘርአ: ዘርእ — and the seed of (ወ- + noun, construct 'seed of'; ወዘርአ ይስሓቅ 'and the seed of Isaac')
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወዘከመ: ዘከመ — and how, in the way that (ወ- 'and' + ዘከመ, ዘ- + ከመ)
glossary.ወየበበት: የበበ — and she cried out (?) (ወ- + 3fs perfect of the quadriliteral የበበ; sense from context) (?)
glossary.ወያመዘብሩ: መዘበረ — and they ravage, plunder (ወ- + 3mp imperfect; the form ya-ʾa-mäzäbbəru is the regular ʾa-stem (causative) imperfect of the quadriliteral መዘበረ 'plunder', or the plain stem is meant) (?)
glossary.ወዮናንስጥ: ዮናንስጥ — and Yonanst (ወ- + proper name or ethnic name; perhaps Greece or the Greeks) (?)
glossary.ወዲባጋት: ዲባግ — and brocades (ወ- + plural ዲባጋት; a loan word for silk brocade) (?)
glossary.ወጋኝተ: ጋኝት — and mares (?) (ወ- + noun, accusative; sense guessed from እለ ይወልዳ 'which bear') (?)
glossary.ወጐድአት: ጐድአ — and she bent, bowed (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G, gʷ-d-ʾ; sense from context) (?)
glossary.ወጠብሐት: ጠብሐ — and she slaughtered (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G, ṭ-b-ḥ)
glossary.ወጠፍሐት: ጠፍሐ — and she spread out, clapped (?) (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G; sense from context) (?)
glossary.ወፈድፋደሰ: ፈድፋደ — and especially, and the more so
glossary.ወፊንቃና: ፊንቃና — and Finqana (ወ- + proper name, a people or land; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወፌርዜዎን: ፌርዜዎን — and the Perizzites (ወ- 'and' + ethnic name, plural)
glossary.ወ፸፻: ፸፻ — and 7,000, spoken ወሰብዓ ምእት (wä-säbʿa məʾət) 'and seventy hundred' (ወ- + numeral; spoken form uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወ፼: ፼ — and 10,000, spoken ወትእልፍት (wä-təʾəlfət) 'and ten thousand' (ወ- + numeral; spoken form uncertain) (?)
glossary.ውሳጥያቲሃ: ውሳጢ — her inward parts, inner being (noun, plural ውሳጥያት + -ሃ '3fs her'; the seat of feeling) (?)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውተፈሥሑ: ተፈሥሐ — and they rejoiced (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem, f-ś-ḥ; written ውተፈሥሑ in the source, an apparent slip for ወተፈሥሑ)
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ዐቀብተ: ዐቃቢ — guards, guardians of (noun, plural ዐቀብት, construct)
glossary.ዐዋዴ: ዐዋዴ — herald, proclamation (noun, accusative; from ዐወደ 'go round'; sense from context) (?)
glossary.ዐግያት: ዐግያት — (?) cords, bands (noun, plural; the singular and the sense are uncertain) (?)
glossary.ዕፍረተ: ዕፍረት — perfume, ointment (noun, fem.; construct 'perfume of')
glossary.ዘለሊሃ: ለሊሁ — which she herself (ዘ- relative + ለሊ- 'self' + -ሃ '3fs her'; ዘለሊሃ አሕነጸታ 'which she herself built')
glossary.ዘለኵልነ: ኵሉ — who is for all of us (ዘ- relative + ለ- 'for' + ኵሉ 'all' + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
glossary.ዘበሕጉ: ሕግ — what is by his law (ዘ- 'that which' + በ- 'by' + ሕግ 'law' + -ሁ 'his', contracted -ጉ)
glossary.ዘበደኃሪ: ደኃሪ — who in the last (ዘ- + በ- + ደኃሪ 'last, later'; ዘበደኃሪ መዋዕል 'in the last days')
glossary.ዘአልቦ: አልቦ — which has not, there is not (ዘ- + አልቦ 'not-with-him', negative existential) · in whom there is no (ዘ- agrees with ቦቱ 'in him', Christ; ዘአልቦ ቈላፈ 'in whom there is no uncircumcised')
glossary.ዘእምታሕቴሃ: ታሕት — which is from beneath her, under her rule (ዘ- relative + እም- 'from' + ታሕት 'beneath', ታሕቴ- + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ዘኮነ: ኮነ — that which was (ዘ- 'that which' + 3ms perfect, k-w-n)
glossary.ዘውእቱ: ውእቱ — who is, namely (ዘ- relative + 3ms pronoun)
glossary.ዘይቤ: ብህለ — who said, which he said (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ዛነ: እኁዝ — holders (second part of the wrongly divided እኁዛነ; ዛነ is no word by itself; see እኁ)
glossary.የዐቅቡ: ዐቀበ — who keep (3mp imperfect, G, ʿ-q-b)
glossary.ያዐቢ: አዐበየ — he makes great, magnifies (3ms imperfect, causative, ʿ-b-y)
glossary.ይስሓቅኒ: ይስሓቅ — Isaac also (proper name + enclitic -ኒ 'also, indeed')
glossary.ይስዕር: ሰዐረ — he abolishes, destroys (3ms imperfect/subjunctive, G, s-ʿ-r; the construction after ፈቀደ is hard) (?)
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይትቀበልዎ: ተቀበለ — that they receive him (3mp subjunctive, tä-stem, q-b-l + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ይትኤዘዝ: ተኤዘዘ — he obeys, is obedient (3ms imperfect, tä-stem, ʾ-z-z)
glossary.ይንግርዋ: ነገረ — that they tell her (3mp subjunctive, G, n-g-r + -ሃ '3fs her', written -ዋ)
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
glossary.ይወልዳ: ወለደ — they bear, give birth (3fp imperfect, G, w-l-d)
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ደባትሪሃ: ደብተራ — her tents (noun, plural ደባትር + -ሃ '3fs her'; the suffix refers to Zion)
glossary.ደባትራ: ደብተራ — tents, hangings (noun, plural ደባትር, accusative ደባትራ)
glossary.ደወሎሙ: ደወል — their bells (?) (noun + -ሙ '3mp their'; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ገብአ: ገብአ — he returned (3ms perfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
glossary.ፀር: ፀር — enemy (noun; genitive after the construct አህጉረ, 'of the enemy') · nominative, collective 'an enemy' (ወይበልዕ ፀር እለ ኢታአምር 'an enemy you do not know will eat')
glossary.ፀብኣ: ፀብእ — host, army, in battle array (noun, accusative); or 'her army' (ፀብእ + -ሃ '3fs her', written -ኣ) (?)
glossary.ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ፍሥሓ: ፍሥሓ — joy (construct 'joy of') · also the plain accusative 'joy' with an adjective (ኀብሩ ፍሥሓ ዐቢየ 'they joined in great joy')
glossary.፫፻: ፫፻ — 300, spoken ሠለስቱ ምእት (śälästu məʾət) 'three hundred' (numeral)
glossary.፫፼ወ፳፻: ፫፼ወ፳፻ — 32,000, spoken ሠለስቱ ትእልፊት ወዕሥራ ምእት (śälästu təʾəlfit wä-ʿəśra məʾət) 'thirty-two thousand' (literally three ten-thousands and twenty hundreds); the spoken form is uncertain (numeral) (?)
glossary.፯፻: ፯፻ — 700, spoken ሰብዐቱ ምእት (säbʿatu məʾət) 'seven hundred' (numeral)
glossary.፲፻: ፲፻ — 1000, spoken ዐሠርቱ ምእት (ʿäśärtu məʾət) 'ten hundred, a thousand' (numeral)
glossary.፸ወ፯፻: ፸ወ፯፻ — 770, spoken ሰብዐቱ ምእት ወሰብዓ (säbʿatu məʾət wä-säbʿa) 'seven hundred and seventy' (numeral)
glossary.፹፫: ፹፫ — 83, spoken ሰማንያ ወሠለስቱ (sämanya wä-śälästu) 'eighty-three'; chapter number (numeral)
glossary.፹፬: ፹፬ — 84, spoken ሰማንያ ወአርባዕቱ (sämanya wä-ʾärbaʿtu) 'eighty-four'; chapter number (numeral)
glossary.፹፭: ፹፭ — 85, spoken ሰማንያ ወኀምስቱ (sämanya wä-ḫaməstu) 'eighty-five'; chapter number (numeral)
glossary.፹፮: ፹፮ — 86, spoken ሰማንያ ወስድስቱ (sämanya wä-sədəstu) 'eighty-six'; chapter number (numeral)
